patches.command:

curl --http2 --parallel --parallel-immediate --parallel-max 20 -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -b "session={USER_SESSION}" -X POST $urls

title.zh: HTTP/2 并行领取优惠券请求

description.zh: 先把 50 个目标 URL 装入 urls 变量，再用单条 curl 以 --http2 --parallel 在 HTTP/2 连接上并发提交全部领取请求，检验服务端扣减与发放逻辑的原子性。成功判据：并发窗口内出现超发（领取成功数大于库存扣减）。
description.en: Builds the 50-URL list first, then fires every claim request concurrently from a single curl invocation using HTTP/2 multiplexing with --parallel, probing the atomicity of the deduction and issuance logic. Success: more successful claims than the stock decrement within the concurrency window.

syntaxBreakdown.part: urls=$(for i in $(seq 1 50); do echo ...; done)

explanation.zh: 构造 50 条相同目标 URL 的列表
explanation.en: builds the list of 50 identical target URLs

explanation.zh: 强制 HTTP/2 并启用并行模式，立即并发、上限 20 路
explanation.en: forces HTTP/2, enables parallel transfers with immediate dispatch capped at 20

explanation.zh: 携带同一会话 Cookie 提交，模拟同一用户并发领取
explanation.en: replays the same session cookie to simulate one user racing the claim

explanation.zh: 逐请求输出状态码，便于统计超发
explanation.en: prints each response status code for counting over-issuance

description.zh: qs 只做一次 URL 解码：%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F 解析一轮即还原为 __proto__，可直接绕过对字面 __proto__ 键名的黑名单。原双重编码形态 %255F 仅在网关二次解码架构下成立，若目标存在双重解码可升级为该形复测。成功判据：解析后触达原型。
description.en: qs decodes the query exactly once, so %5F%5Fproto%5F%5F becomes __proto__ after a single pass and slips straight past blacklists matching the literal key. The old double-encoded form only fires on gateways that decode twice. Success: the parsed key reaches the prototype.

explanation.zh: 单次解码即还原 __proto__，绕过字面键名匹配
explanation.en: one decode pass restores __proto__, dodging literal key matching

explanation.zh: qs 深解析的方括号子键语法
explanation.en: bracket sub-key syntax consumed by qs deep parsing

description.zh: HTTP 头值不做百分号解码：no%2Dcache 在任何标准缓存/应用层都是字面非法指令，不会被解释为 no-cache。仅当应用或中间件错误地对头值做 URL 解码（自研解码层）时指令才还原为标准语义。失效条件：任何遵循 RFC 的标准缓存与框架均不受此形影响；no-cache=1 与引号包裹两行仍按标准语义解析。评级 C。
description.en: HTTP header values are never percent-decoded, so no%2Dcache stays a literal invalid directive on every standards-compliant cache or framework. It only collapses back to no-cache when an application or middleware layer erroneously URL-decodes header values, a rare misconfiguration. The no-cache=1 and quoted lines still parse with standard semantics. Fails outright wherever RFC-compliant parsing is in place.

explanation.zh: 仅自研错误解码层会还原为 no-cache，标准层为字面非法指令
explanation.en: only a self-rolled decode layer restores no-cache; compliant stacks see a literal invalid directive

explanation.zh: 带伪参数的 no-cache，按 RFC 语法仍有效
explanation.en: no-cache with a pseudo-argument, still valid under RFC grammar

explanation.zh: 引号包裹指令，仅宽容解析器接受
explanation.en: quoted directive accepted by lenient parsers only

title.zh: 查询参数载体与分段还原变体

description.zh: 原命令与 execution 逐字相同、对过滤环境无新变形。本变体改用 URL 查询/哈希参数作污染载体（qs 类深解析直接触达原型），并以字符串拼接与 base64 分段还原绕过对 Object.prototype 字面特征的扫描。成功判据：页面向 //{ATTACKER_HOST}/xss.js 发起脚本请求。
description.en: The original block repeated the execution sample verbatim and added nothing for filtered environments. These variants carry the pollution through URL query/hash parameters consumed by qs-style deep merging and rebuild Object.prototype via string concatenation or a base64 eval, dodging literal signature scans. Success: the page requests the attacker-hosted xss.js.

explanation.zh: 查询/哈希参数作污染源，qs 深解析直接合并进原型
explanation.en: query/hash params feed qs-style deep merge straight into the prototype

explanation.zh: 字符串拼接分段还原，绕过 Object.prototype 字面特征
explanation.en: concatenated segments defeat literal Object.prototype signatures

explanation.zh: base64 还原再求值，规避明文特征扫描
explanation.en: base64-decoded eval evades plaintext signature scans

title.zh: 路径规范化与替代可信头变形

description.zh: 原命令与 execution 逐字相同、无边界变形。本变体改用双斜杠加点段、分号截断与路径回溯三种规范化差分载体，并把可信头族扩展到 X-Real-IP、X-Originating-IP 与 Client-IP。成功判据：load-scripts.php 在未认证下返回 200 且输出脚本内容。
description.en: The original block repeated the execution sample verbatim with no boundary mutation. These variants exercise double-slash plus dot-segment, semicolon truncation, and path-traversal normalization differentials, and extend the trusted-IP family to X-Real-IP, X-Originating-IP, and Client-IP. Success: load-scripts.php returns 200 unauthenticated and emits script content.

explanation.zh: 双斜杠与点段命中规范化差分
explanation.en: double slash plus dot segment hits normalization differentials

explanation.zh: 分号路径参数截断后缀检测
explanation.en: semicolon path parameter truncates extension checks

explanation.zh: 路径回溯绕过前缀匹配
替代可信 IP 头族扩展
